[plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED, by design (no abort option in this build's declaration), disclosed in code, README and how-to; host timeout UNKNOWN; not yet accepted by the operator.

findings.title: No dedicated test that /done alone resets the 90-minute continuous-focus nudge clock (only /break is asserted).
findings.body: stopContinuous is called in the done handler (register.tsx); test 'a break resets the 90-minute continuous-focus clock' covers break only. Behaviour likely correct but unguarded against regression. [plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.test.ts] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED against register.test.ts; the code calls stopContinuous in the done handler.

findings.title: The recovery toast "ADHD engine is back" can fire on the first successful poll after an initial failure even though the engine was never up in the session.
findings.body: wasUp becomes false on first down (including 2s timeout); next ok with wasUp===false triggers recovery toast. T2 expects ['ADHD engine is back'] after slow->healthy without a prior ok. Docs describe toast as coming back from reachable. [plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED and PRE-EXISTING (logic unchanged since the PULSE-001 audited head); docs say "comes back".
